name: chamfer_lean
description: Pretraining candidate: the completed reference C + D0 + M3D (i2-m3d) with the hard-opacity depth pass, depth-gradient loss and visibility regulariser removed (occlusion/free-space already 0) and a bidirectional 3D Chamfer loss between all decoded Gaussian centres and the training cameras' fused depth cloud added at each reconstructed timestep. Not "D2" (historical D2 also had occlusion).

config.variant_text:
# Variant chamfer_lean (registered 2026-10-21; a pretraining candidate, not the frozen method). Base: the completed
# reference C + D0 + M3D (method-frozen-v1); its four registered overrides are repeated here. Not "D2": the historical
# D2 also had occlusion supervision.
# Kept: RGB reconstruction (L1 + SSIM), Gaussian-space 3D motion (M3D), expected-depth L1, alpha coverage, InfoNCE,
#   slot consistency, the synthetic-view setup (2 views, also render targets), temporal ramp, encoder, decoder,
#   Gaussian counts, anchor initialisation, temporal sampling, splits, rendering settings.
# Removed (each skipped entirely, not multiplied by zero): hard-opacity depth pass and its loss, multi-scale
#   depth-gradient loss, visibility regulariser, occlusion/free-space loss (already 0 in the reference).
# Added: bidirectional 3D Chamfer between all decoded Gaussian centres and the training cameras' fused depth at each
#   reconstructed timestep (s4d/losses/chamfer.py): 0.5 mean_g min_p |g-p|^2 + 0.5 mean_p min_g |p-g|^2, metric,
#   no alignment; target points: depth > 0 and < far (3.0 m), 1 cm voxel means, 4096 points per sample and timestep,
#   uniform over voxels. Weight 5 fixed by the training-only gradient-scale check
#   runs/setup/chamfer-weight-check-20261021.json (rule v2) before any candidate training.
# Computation: the diagnostic motion-feature render runs only on logging/evaluation steps (identical reported metrics).
aug:
  synth_views: 2
  synth_render: true
loss:
  depth_valid_far: true
  motion_space: gaussian
  depth_hard: 0.0
  depth_grad: 0.0
  visibility: 0.0
  occlusion: 0.0
  chamfer: 5.0
  chamfer_points: 4096
  chamfer_voxel_m: 0.01
  motion_feature_render: log_steps

loss.formula: L = 0.5 * mean_g min_p ||g - p||^2 + 0.5 * mean_p min_g ||p - g||^2 (metres^2), per sample and reconstructed timestep, averaged over valid samples; added to the render loss with weight 5
loss.gaussians: all decoded Gaussian centres (static and dynamic) at that timestep; no opacity or contribution filter; no alignment
loss.targets: training cameras of the batch only (no held-out or moving-camera data): every pixel lifted with its stored depth and calibration; valid if depth > 0 and < far (3.0 m, loss.depth_valid_far); 1 cm voxel means (one point per occupied voxel, across views); 4096 points per sample and timestep sampled uniformly over voxels (without replacement when enough voxels exist)
loss.nearest_neighbours: exact fp32, fused Triton kernel (bounded memory, no distance matrix), argmin without gradient, squared distance recomputed with gradient at the argmin

weight.rule: v2: lambda = median |grad (0.5 hard-depth + 0.5 depth-gradient)| / |grad C| over task x state x batch, rounded to the nearest 1-2-5 value (v1 used R including the visibility term; see the comment above)
weight.note: rule v1 (including the visibility term) gave ~108 because of the visibility initialisation transient; v2 matches the gradient scale of the removed depth terms. Fixed before any candidate training; no sweep.

computation: disabled terms are skipped (no hard-opacity render, no depth-gradient or visibility computation); the diagnostic motion-feature render runs only on logging steps (loss.motion_feature_render: log_steps), with identical logged metrics

pilot.comparison: i2-m3d-seed0 in-training evaluation at 50k (same seed); i2-m3d-seed1 50k checkpoints (full evaluation and diagnostics); i2-m3d-seed0 100k for context
